freeze_policy: verdict criteria frozen from the handler's directive alone; no factor data fetched and no factor number computed at freeze time
directive_ref: feno-handoff fh-20260806-175-cc-b563494b (handler: cc; owner-amended contract, commit 671202c61b)

handler_decisions.representative_value: midpoint (endpoint ranks remain a reported diagnostic; switching to low post-X0 would be fitting to result)
handler_decisions.primary_metric: rank correlation; directional_rate demoted, not used in any verdict
handler_decisions.origin_sets: all 34 + the 18 window-complete ones, both required for every statistic

origin_sets_frozen.rule: window_complete = baseline window_years >= 9.5 of the requested 10y span (X0 P0-3 reversal set)

contains: Big Value minus Big Growth = (ME5,BM5) - (ME5,BM1) monthly

method.window: each origin's subsequent 36 months: compound the monthly factor returns over (t, t+36m]; the basket's 36m cumulative total return over the SAME window
method.period_window: 2015-01 .. 2023-12 cumulative factor returns (the origin span's matched period)
method.residual: pooled OLS per origin set: y = basket 36m cumulative total return on X = [1, MktRF36, HML36, RMW36, CMA36, MOM36]; factor-residual return = y - yhat
method.primary_signal: bottom-up V/P (midpoint) vs 36m cumulative return (raw and factor-residual), Spearman rank correlation with own moving-block bootstrap CI and ESS; top-down V/P reported alongside
method.both_origin_sets: all 34 and the 18 window-complete origins — every statistic computed on both (handler decision)

verdict_criteria.scope: X1 factor/period control for the E2 bottom-up RIM signal on the fixed Dow-30 basket; factors are regime CONTEXT, never a substitute baseline (contract 6 X1)
verdict_criteria.origin_sets: all_34 + window_complete_18 (both required for every statistic)

insufficient_matched_universe.directive_rule: the Dow basket cannot be matched to the factor universe closely enough to interpret the residual
insufficient_matched_universe.operational: any required 36m origin window has missing factor months (data gap), OR the pooled OLS R2 < 0.50 on BOTH origin sets (the factors barely co-move with the basket, so residuals are uninterpretable); do not force a number
insufficient_matched_universe.fail_when: data gap in any origin window, or R2 < 0.50 on both sets

period_effect_explains_most.directive_rule: value factors are materially negative over the matched window AND the RIM signal's rank correlation against FACTOR-RESIDUAL returns turns positive on both origin sets
period_effect_explains_most.operational: cumulative HML over 2015-01..2023-12 < 0 (materially negative, magnitude reported) AND spearman(bottom-up V/P, factor-residual 36m return) > 0 on BOTH origin sets
period_effect_explains_most.pass_when: HML_cum_2015_2023 < 0 AND residual_rho > 0 on both sets

period_effect_partial_only.directive_rule: factor-residual rank improves versus raw but remains <= 0 on at least one origin set
period_effect_partial_only.operational: residual_rho > raw_rho on BOTH origin sets (improvement on the same set) AND residual_rho <= 0 on at least one set
period_effect_partial_only.pass_when: residual_rho > raw_rho on both sets AND residual_rho <= 0 on >= 1 set

model_failure_remains.directive_rule: factor-residual rank stays <= 0 on both origin sets
model_failure_remains.operational: residual_rho <= 0 on BOTH origin sets (or no criteria above is met — conservative default)
model_failure_remains.pass_when: residual_rho <= 0 on both sets, or no other criterion fires

verdict_criteria.freeze_mechanism: criteria emitted as data by x1-criteria.mjs before any X1 number exists, consumed fail-closed by x1-factor-regime.mjs
